qt: to the Commission Moritz Körner (Renew) Subject:

The Commission failed to answer the questions raised in parliamentary question E-002745/20231. The Commission is asked to answer the following questions separately and directly: On 12 April 2023, the Commission published its progress report on the implementation of the LGBTIQ Equality Strategy 2020-2025. In the report, the Commission mentions a survey among Member States to self-assess progress on the implementation of the LGBTIQ Equality Strategy. 1.
Which nine Member States did not submit responses to the survey?
How does the Commission assess the implementation of the LGBTIQ Equality Strategy in each of these Member States?
at: (English version) to the Commission Moritz Körner (Renew) (9 January 2024) Subject: Implementation of the EU LGBTIQ Equality Strategy in the Member States (2) The Commission failed to answer the questions raised in parliamentary Question E-002745/2023 (1). The Commission is asked to answer the following questions separately and directly: On 12 April 2023, the Commission published its progress report on the implementation of the LGBTIQ Equality Strategy 2020-2025. In the report, the Commission mentions a survey among Member States to self-assess progress on the implementation of the LGBTIQ Equality Strategy. 1.
Which nine Member States did not submit responses to the survey?
How does the Commission assess the implementation of the LGBTIQ Equality Strategy in each of these Member States?

(20 March 2024) 1. The LGBTIQ Equality Strategy 2020-2025 (2) and the Guidelines for strategies and action plans to enhance LGBTIQ equality (3) do not oblige Member States to provide the Commission input on the implementation of the strategy. As the Commission pointed out in its reply to written parliamentary Question E-002745/2023, besides the 2022 non-mandatory online survey referred to by the Honourable Member, additional information from Member States concerning the implementation of the strategy was obtained through other channels. These include an online survey launched in 2023 for the mid-term review of the strategy and exchanges in meetings of the LGBTIQ Equality Subgroup. All inputs, complemented with dialogue with Member States and other stakeholders, provided a comprehensive basis on the situation in all Member States presented in the progress report referred to by the Honourable Member, and for the ongoing mid-term review of the strategy. 2. The Commission is continuing assessing the implementation of the strategy, by preparing a mid-term review which will analyse how the situation of LGBTIQ people has developed, the progress that has been made, and which areas require more focus to fully implement the strategy by 2025. It will also reflect on developments at national level.
